meta.name: rescue
meta.description: Triage an outage, loss of stakeholder trust or a failing engagement direction. Use for urgent recovery; distinguish diagnosis from authorized production mitigation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 突发故障或合作僵局时,快速理清状况并排出恢复步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果线上服务突然中断或重要合作濒临破裂,需要马上定出恢复方案。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a sudden outage or stalled engagement into a clear recovery plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a live outage or a breaking partnership needs a recovery plan right now

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先读任务上下文契约和方法，再对故障、信任流失或方向走偏做紧急分诊：区分诊断与经授权的生产缓解，并如实报告未运行的检查。
howto.when: 当你需要紧急恢复时接管：线上故障、利益相关方信任流失，或项目方向走偏等情形；它不重启已由 @fde 回答过的设置与问题。

say.text: 线上服务挂了，帮我做紧急分诊。
say.note: 先读上下文契约与方法，再区分诊断和授权处置

say.text: 客户对我们已经不太信任了，帮我评估怎么挽回。
say.note: 按方法梳理信任流失，保留未知项

say.text: 这个项目方向好像跑偏了，帮我判断怎么收。
say.note: 输出恢复方向，不虚构未做的检查

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude reads the task context contract and method first, then triages an outage, lost stakeholder trust or a failing direction: it separates diagnosis from authorized production mitigation and reports unrun checks honestly.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you need urgent recovery: an outage, loss of stakeholder trust, or a failing engagement direction. It does not restart setup or questions already answered by @fde.

say_en.text: The service is down, help me triage the outage.
say_en.note: Reads context contract and method, splits diagnosis from mitigation

say_en.text: The client has lost trust in us, help me assess recovery.
This project direction seems off track, help me decide.
say_en.note: Gives a recovery direction, no invented checks
